campaign.objective: Read the merchant, date, and total fields from photographed shop receipts.
pipeline: page crop: finds the receipt in the photo
line finder: splits the receipt into text lines
field reader: labels lines as merchant, date, or total
campaign.primary_metric: receipts with all three fields correct (higher is better)

miss_table.note: lines run diagonally; A cuts across them
light text; A finds no line gaps
total written by hand under the print
lines found correctly, but two totals are printed

saved_methods.B: learned text-line detector from Paper 1; misses handwritten totals, handles tilted photos and faded print
saved_methods.C: deskew-then-profile from Paper 2; misses faded print, handles tilted photos and handwritten totals

sources.paper_1: Learned text-line detection. Ablation table: +7 points on its faded-print subset over a profile baseline; overall 0.86 vs 0.81 on its own benchmark.
sources.paper_2: Deskew before profiling. Ablation table: +11 points on its rotated-page subset; no change on upright pages.

team_notes: Paper 1 scores higher overall, so let's replace A with B.
The field reader feels like the weak step; maybe fine-tune it next.
Let's group the misses by how wrong the total was (off by under 1, off by over 10) and attack the worst group.
